camera_policy.overview: All tasks use one native overview fitted directly to the exact user-supplied L3-03 image. Shared world pose, projection and sensor raster; no per-task camera changes and no output-image warp.
camera_policy.wrists: Fixed link6-relative mounts and projections shared from L3-03; cameras follow their own arms.
camera_policy.source: Latest user instruction: make L3-03 match the supplied image and use this exact view for all tasks; this supersedes the earlier original-no-turn choice.
camera_policy.static_environment: Same table/room geometry; use L3-03 wall-strip transform and the reference invisibility of the external camera stand. Keep task props and robot initial states.

historical_real_video_edge_annotations.method: Original L3-03 framing restored exactly. Real-image edge deviations are diagnostic only; no camera re-fit or horizontal turn.
